issues.reason: Dual-emit for an adjective's PP complement mandates keeping the flat copular atom beside the reified state ("keep the flat copular atom (dual-emit as always)"), and on a plural that half becomes the per-member `(Implication (PartOf $x <group>) (Member $x <state>))` — omitting it drops an atom the instruction set makes determined, not optional.

defect_summary: The compliant form adds the distributed flat half — either `(Member $x visible)` as a further conjunct of the existing rule's consequent, or a sibling `(: cs_visible_flat (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) (Member $x visible)) (STV 1.0 0.9))` — beside the reified per-member state.
notes: The reified-state route with the surface-preposition `From` on the state witness is right (the fused adjective+complement form is bare-kinds-only), as is distributing over `(PartOf $x sk_group_1)` instead of predicating on the group symbol; `cliff_spire`'s head genus with the noun modifier unexposed is also correct.
